scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.reboot: pm2 stop mechatroniqs-backend && pm2 delete mechatroniqs-backend && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js && pm2 save
scripts.deploy: npm run build && pm2 restart mechatroniqs-backend
scripts.push: git add . && git commit -m "${npm_config_msg:-Update}" || true && git push origin main
scripts.pull: git pull origin main && npm run build && pm2 restart mechatroniqs-backend
